title: London Discovery Benchmark task
description: A single frozen benchmark task. Structure only: this schema constrains the SHAPE of a task, never its content or difficulty. Authored task text is out of scope here and gated on the RATIFY-19-06 eligibility decision.

task_template_id.description: Grouping key for leakage control (F-07 PD-6). All paraphrases and threshold variants of the same underlying question share this id and MUST land in the same split.

family.description: Query family. Frozen set; adding a family is a protocol change, not a task edit.

suite.description: Naturalistic = realistic user tasks. Diagnostic = planted-defect probes. Robustness = paraphrase/injection/defect variants.

split.description: Partition assignment (F-07 §5). Assigned by grouped random assignment on task_template_id, seeded, before freeze.

query_text.description: The task as presented. Frozen at benchmark freeze.

constraints.description: Machine-readable constraints the task states. Each maps to atomic predicates in the evidence gate.

value.description: Scalar or array, per operator. 'one_of' and 'within' take arrays.

hardness.description: Hard constraints route to the evidence gate; soft constraints route to preference utility. A constraint may be reclassified only through the dialogue's must-versus-nice question, never silently.

borough.description: London borough of the sampled origin, spelled exactly as in the frozen geo reference. Amended from LSOA/IMD origin 2026-08-29: no LSOA or IMD file exists on any branch, and deprivation_tertile fed only F-12 equity analysis, which is out of scope.

planted_defect.description: Diagnostic suite only. Declares the defect this task probes.

expected_state.description: The evidence state a correct system should reach. Never a relevance judgment.

paraphrase_of.description: Robustness suite only. The task this one paraphrases. MUST share its task_template_id.

notes.description: Author notes. Never shown to assessors.
